checks.detail: 326 tracts with population and coordinates; all IDs are 11 characters with prefix 13121.
pct_checkup_gap = 100 − pct_checkup, so a low checkup rate raises need.
disease_weekly is the Clayton, DeKalb, Fulton, Gwinnett Health Service Area; excluded from tract ranking.
Last non-empty week 2024-09-28; 107 of 212 weeks are blank.
0 live HPSA areas (all 99 designations are Proposed For Withdrawal); HPSA_SCORE unavailable.
exposure_tracts is a 12 km grid on tract IDs; given zero ranking weight.
No race/ethnicity or personal columns reach the planner's evidence.

prohibited_claims_blocked: tract-level respiratory trend from an HSA figure
travel time inferred from straight-line distance
caveats: 4 SPATIAL RESOLUTIONS (TRACT != 12KM GRID != FACILITY POINT != 4-COUNTY HSA): weekly respiratory ED trends describe the 4-county Health Service Area, never a census tract; PM2.5 is a 12 km grid and cannot rank neighborhoods.
DISTANCE != JOURNEY TIME: km_to_any_care and km_to_safety_net are straight-line upper bounds to federal facilities, not bus or road travel times.
PLACES MODELED ESTIMATES: tract prevalences are small-area model estimates, not counts; differences of 1–2 points fall within overlapping 95% confidence intervals.
UPPER-BOUND FEDERAL FACILITIES: free clinics, county clinics and pharmacies are not in any licensed national list, so every distance is an upper bound.

outreach.regional_surveillance_note_en: Flu and COVID numbers are only reported for the whole Clayton, DeKalb, Fulton, Gwinnett area, not for your neighborhood. The latest numbers we have are from 2024-09-28.
outreach.regional_surveillance_note_es: Los datos de gripe y COVID solo se reportan para toda el área de Clayton, DeKalb, Fulton, Gwinnett, no para su vecindario. Los datos más recientes son de 2024-09-28.

limitations: Bus travel time: no license-clean federal dataset exists; the best transit matrix is CC BY-NC. Distances are straight-line upper bounds.
Free and county clinics: no national list exists. Facility layers are federal only (CMS + HRSA).
Pharmacies: excluded. NPPES carries practitioner names and home addresses.
Other mobile clinics: the one national registry has no license or bulk download; not scraped.
How many people have asthma: unknown. CDC PLACES gives modeled prevalence, not counts.
Is COVID rising in this neighborhood: unanswerable. disease_weekly is a 4-county HSA figure.
Which specific people are unmanaged: none, by design. Individual-level data is prohibited.
